source: the model header (Trace conformance) and its SigmaObs/H definitions
hidden: H = diff(Events, SigmaObs): rounds, a_en results 0/1, a_dis, a_chk/w_chk, signals, p_sig, p_rel, w_xw, a_self, stale flags, idle, bound_exceeded
projection: one Alternative object with its two rendezvous channels and their partners

configurations.name: SYS
requires: the Alternative has exactly two guards, both rendezvous input guards (c0 = guard 0, c1 = guard 1)
each channel carries exactly one message, from one partner: a plain writer (PW), a signal sender (SW) or an ALT writer with this one output guard (AW)
no other reader on either channel

events.model: a_sel.g.b.o; b: a RendezvousDone on c_g with A as reader since A's previous AltSelected; o: one on the other channel

events.trace: AltSelected of ALT writer i, or the Resume ending plain writer i's WaitChannel(write)
events.model: w_done.i.b (b: a RendezvousDone names writer i on c_i)

events.trace: WaitAlt + Resume of ALT writer i

generator: matching only: the mapping of a_act/a_en needs a replay of the state word (model header, Gaps); not generated until a recorded instance matches
gaps: a_act.i.true is the take or the claim only when A was not claimed before; a trace does not say which
enable/disable results and state words are not recorded
